verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents deploying itself on your own Linux server, which lets you decide where vault data physically lives, and its API docs reference a self-hosted domain alongside the cloud. However, nothing in the evidence shows a choice of cloud hosting region, so residency control is only shown through self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/residency selection, any residency or compliance guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
